annotations.title: Embed code for a spectrum chart, calculator, lounge card or seat map

description: The HTML that puts one of the sites' widgets on another website: a 567politics spectrum chart (page_url=https://567politics.com/political-spectrum?country=<verified-slug>), Points Frog calculator, program points value or award checker, Lounge Frog lounge card, Seats Frog seat map, or Cruises Frog drinks package calculator. Embeds are free, require no reader login, have no ads or analytics, and resize to fit. For Frog article bodies use the returned preview URL alone in a Markdown paragraph, never the HTML snippet. Actively use spectrum charts in relevant political reporting as a distinctive visual explanation of party, faction and politician differences.

page_url.description: The page to embed, e.g. https://www.pointsfrog.com/mortgage-calculator or https://www.loungefrog.com/lounges/jfk-the-centurion-lounge

theme.description: light or dark to match the website; auto (the default) follows each reader's device setting
